kind: EQ164 wave 3 story W3-B2: second half of ambiguous scanner consumers
status: FINDINGS ONLY; adjudicated finding / proposed resolution; nothing accepted; no tracker edited

selection.rule: consumers with primary gap class AMBIGUOUS and id S####, sorted ascending; this record is the last floor(n/2)

patterns.text: 22 rules read only an ordered daily bar series through one indicator family each; three families under closed baseline #472 (18 rules) and one under #473 (4 rules). All carry the same two gaps: reuse proof and exact profile. The public baseline dispositions record zero accepted canonical reuses.

12 rules compare a price against level or range operands: 8 with per-period initialization under closed #33 plus #508/#506 fields, and 4 (S0198, S0208, S0209, S0218) with direct level and range operands under #33/#34. The level fields F0347-F0350 and F0351 route to closed baselines (reuse unproved).

7 rules (S0197, S0199, S0200, S0201, S0205, S0206, S0207) have every named field operand routed to open EF1 owners #506/#507/#508 or delivered (F0271, F0284); only contract-time profile selection and per-field delivery mapping remain.
4 category rules (S0329-S0332) use two context scalars that have no F id in the field catalogue plus a third whose supplied-versus-computed origin is unresolved: STILL_AMBIGUOUS.

3 adaptive rules (S0336, S0337, S0357) are named at output level only through the provisional public answer X3-4; all depend on one supplied rate operand F0702 whose upstream ordered profile under #492 is unselected and on a #626 contract that does not exist.
4 rules (S0338, S0339, S0353, S0354) share an identical 9-field operand set owned by #490 plus #489 cohort freeze and a closed #23 baseline; they are one gap for producer-demand purposes, not four.
2 rules (S0334, S0335) read one per-symbol aggregate volume row value (inferred F0098 or F0097, #23 closed) and a direction field F0206 (#507); the aggregate profile choice is unselected.

No rule needed a PROPOSED_NEW_STORY from the wave 2 decisions; the only possible new stories are conditional (a narrow variant story if baseline reuse proof fails; a cohort-normalization producer if decision Q3 is yes).

decisions_needed.text: For the 26+ rules whose series operand routes to a closed baseline story (22 under #472/#473, 4 under #34, plus level fields under #33/#34 and aggregate fields under #23): what proof standard and which author accepts reuse of the closed baseline for a given source profile, and if the proof fails, may one narrow variant story per indicator family (FAM-A to FAM-F) be proposed?

For S0329-S0332: are the three context scalars that have no F id added to the field catalogue as supplied facts under the EF2 I/O layer (#609), or are they computed from the bar series inside #34? Which catalogue ids, if any, do they correspond to (candidates F0096, F0151, F0189, F0671 and F0087, F0141 exist only in other contexts)?

For S0338, S0339, S0353, S0354: are the cross-sectional rank operands produced by the #489 cohort freeze alone, or do they require the proposed EF8 cohort-normalization producer (wave 1 C1), which today is demanded only by the ten current-cohort rank rows?

Which EF1 modules on main produce F0188, F0190, F0191, F0206, F0218, F0272, F0273, F0275, F0276 (delivery ledger section 1 lists capabilities, not field mappings)? This decides whether S0197, S0199, S0200, S0201, S0205-S0207 move from planned to delivered operands.

Confirm or overturn X3-4: F0721 computed by #626, F0700 supplied identity under #611, F0702 a value copy of F0193 under #513. Which story names the raw operand producers of #626, and which source profile under #492 feeds F0702?
For S0334, S0335: is the per-symbol aggregate volume value a supplied I/O fact or computed from bars under #23, and which exact source profile and eligibility apply?
For S0210-S0217: which level periods and initialization rules are admitted by #33, and may an unsupported period be refused rather than given a variant story?
For rules whose derived values name two or three EF1 owners (S0197, S0198, S0205, S0206): is the owner of each derived value fixed per output (one owner each) or chosen per rule at contract time?

definitions.DELIVERED_ON_MAIN: operand classified delivered in the wave 1 selected packets (F0271, F0284)
definitions.PLANNED_NUMBERED: operand routed to a numbered story in the public route coverage index; for EF1 owners (#505-#508) per-field delivery is not provable from opaque ids; closed baseline stories count as planned with reuse unproved
definitions.PROPOSED_NEW_STORY: operand needs a story proposed in EQ164_WAVE2_DECISIONS.md (none in this half)
definitions.UNCOVERED_GAP: no catalogue identity or numbered owner can be named for the operand
definitions.RESOLVED_ALL_OPERANDS_COVERED: every operand is named and routed to an open numbered owner or delivered; only contract-time selection remains
definitions.RESOLVED_WITH_GAPS: every operand is named but at least one gap is listed (closed-baseline reuse unproved, absent contract, unselected profile, cohort freeze)
definitions.STILL_AMBIGUOUS: an operand cannot be named or routed; the missing evidence is stated

method: Operand names come from three sources: the X4 record, the private exact field bridges (opaque ids only) and a lexical trace of the private source requirement records mapped to field catalogue ids; indicator families are labelled FAM-A to FAM-F by order of first appearance. Producer status uses the public route coverage index, the selected packets A, B, C and the delivery ledger. The three adaptive rules use the public X3 answer.
limits: lexical field extraction is a proposal, not a certified operand contract
per-field delivery of EF1 owned fields is undetermined
no accepted mathematics, API, source, rights or consumer parity is implied
